name: How long does it take to repair a sliding door that is not closing?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a sliding door that is not closing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most common sliding door repairs, such as track cleaning, roller replacement, or minor alignment adjustments, can typically be completed within a few hours. More complex issues, like significant frame repairs or track replacements, might take a full day. A general contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing the specific damage to your door.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most sliding door repairs for non-closing issues are completed within a few hours; complex repairs may take a full day.
